lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged posterior to the gill slits. The blobs show a roughly equidistant vertical spacing within columns, forming a predictable 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal linear patterns of spots. These intersections define the primary spatial coordinates for the largest and brightest circular nodes visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a light-reflective upper edge and a distinct shadow region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense patterning of small, high-luminance blobs and faint curvilinear markings. Additionally, multiple small, elongated teleost fish (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and pectoral fin.
